summary: First meaningful build from 24 actual TSS — introduces sweet-spot cycling, extends aerobic ride duration, pivots strength entirely to posterior chain and core to respect bilateral knee pain and back constraints

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Ride
sessions.focus: Aerobic base development at Z2 — mitochondrial density, fat oxidation, cardiovascular efficiency with zero tissue stress on recovering knees

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, build cadence from 60 to 80 rpm over 4 min, HR below 135 bpm
Z2 steady aerobic, 80-90 rpm, HR 130-150 bpm, conversational effort — ease to lower bound if HR exceeds 155
Z1 easy spin down, reduce cadence to 65 rpm, HR below 120 bpm before dismounting

sessions.name: Sweet-Spot Introduction 2x8min
sessions.focus: First controlled Z3 sweet-spot exposure to begin raising lactate threshold — tests physiological response before committing to longer threshold blocks

steps.description: Progressive spin: 2 min Z1 below 88W, 3 min building to Z2 106-120W, cadence 80-85 rpm, HR below 145 bpm
Low Z3 sweet-spot, 85-90 rpm, HR 158-168 bpm — comfortably hard, controlled breathing. Dial back to 130-140W if HR exceeds 172 bpm
Z1 easy spin recovery, HR back below 145 bpm before starting next rep
Z1 easy spin down, cadence 65-70 rpm, HR below 120 bpm before dismounting

sessions.name: Posterior Chain and Anti-Rotation Core
sessions.focus: Posterior chain activation (glutes, hamstrings) and anti-rotation core stability — addresses hip stability deficit contributing to anterior knee pain; zero deep knee flexion, zero spinal flexion under load
sessions.notes: 3 rounds. Romanian Deadlift 2x11kg dumbbells x10 reps (hip hinge, back flat, stop if back rounds). Banded Clamshell light band x15 each side. Single-Leg Glute Bridge bodyweight x12 each side (hold 1s at top). Dead Bug bodyweight x8 each side slow. Pallof Press light-medium band x10 each side 3s hold. 60s rest between rounds. All exercises knee-safe — no deep knee flexion anywhere.

steps.description: Glute bridge bodyweight x15, banded hip abduction x12 each side, cat-cow x10 slow, ankle circles x10 each direction
3 rounds: Romanian Deadlift 2x11kg x10 reps, Banded Clamshell x15 each side, Single-Leg Glute Bridge x12 each side, Dead Bug x8 each side, Pallof Press x10 each side 3s hold — 60s rest between rounds
Hip flexor stretch 45s each side, supine hamstring stretch 45s each leg, figure-four glute stretch 45s each side, child's pose 60s

sessions.name: Aerobic Endurance Ride
sessions.focus: Longest aerobic session of the block — extends Z2 time to build cardiac stroke volume, fat oxidation capacity, and peripheral vascular adaptation supporting the primary weight-loss goal

steps.description: Progressive spin: 2 min below 88W Z1, 2 min building to 106W, 2 min settling into 110-120W low Z2, cadence 80-85 rpm
Z2 steady aerobic, 80-90 rpm, HR 146-160 bpm — divide mentally into four 10-min blocks. Ease 5-10W if HR drifts above 162 bpm. Fat oxidation zone — hold steady, no surges
5 min at 88-100W Z1, final 4 min spin down below 80W, cadence falling to 65 rpm, HR below 115 bpm before dismounting

summary: Progress sweet-spot volume to 3x8min and extend Sunday ride to 65 min — first running session if knee pain has resolved and physio gives clearance, otherwise substitute a third cycling session

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Ride
sessions.focus: Z2 aerobic maintenance and recovery from Monday rest

sessions.name: Sweet-Spot 3x8min
sessions.focus: Extend sweet-spot volume — longer lactate threshold stimulus

sessions.name: Posterior Chain and Core — Progression
sessions.focus: Increase RDL to 2x16kg if back tolerates; add TRX hip hinge; progress core anti-extension

sessions.name: Aerobic Endurance Ride
sessions.focus: Extended Z2 duration to 65 min — build aerobic economy and fat-burning capacity

summary: Peak week — introduce first true threshold intervals on the bike (4x8min Z4), add a short easy run if knees are cleared, and push Sunday long ride to 70 min. Highest intensity and volume of the 4-week block.

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Ride
sessions.focus: Z1-Z2 recovery spin — keep legs fresh before Thursday threshold session

sessions.name: Easy Run — First of the Block
sessions.focus: Z1-Z2 easy run debut — if knees cleared by physio, 25 min easy at >6:45/km

sessions.name: Threshold Intervals 4x8min
sessions.focus: Z4 threshold repeats to lift FTP ceiling and maximise cardiovascular adaptation

sessions.name: Full Posterior Chain and Core
sessions.focus: Consolidate glute-hamstring strength and single-leg stability — introduce TRX single-leg RDL

sessions.name: Long Aerobic Endurance Ride
sessions.focus: 70 min Z2 — peak aerobic volume of the block supporting weight loss and base fitness

summary: Recovery week — cut volume by approximately 40%, all intensity drops to Z1-Z2 only. Let the supercompensation from weeks 1-3 land. Two easy rides, one short easy run or walk, no strength loading.

sessions.name: Easy Recovery Spin
sessions.focus: Z1 active recovery — flush metabolic waste, maintain movement habit without adding fatigue

sessions.name: Easy Recovery Run or Walk
sessions.focus: Z1-Z2 easy movement — maintain running adaptation without adding stress

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Ride
sessions.focus: Z2 easy ride — consolidate aerobic adaptations from the build-peak arc
